title: Health of the Toddler: Caring for Your Child’s Body from Two to Three
description: A path to help parents care for their toddler’s health: nutrition after weaning, toddler sleep and nighttime awakenings, monitoring growth milestones, and home safety and accident prevention — with guidance on when to consult a doctor.
